theme: The Question That Separates Good Events from Unforgettable Ones

linkedin.text:
After producing 1,500+ events in 130+ destinations, the single question that predicts success more than budget, venue or headcount:

'What do you want people to feel when they walk out the door?'

HR and marketing leaders who answer that with one crisp sentence — not a bullet list, one sentence — run events people talk about for years. Those who can't answer it end up with an event that looked right on paper and landed flat in the room.

Our whole production methodology is built backwards from that answer. Venue choice, session design, F&B, the final moment of the evening — all of it traces back to a feeling someone named in a first briefing call.

25,000+ participants across our events didn't just attend. They left with something.

If you're planning a conference, incentive trip or company retreat and want to build from that question outward — DM me. Happy to give you 15 minutes of honest thinking before you brief anyone.

facebook.text:
After 1,500+ events across 130+ destinations, one question still separates the good ones from the truly unforgettable ones.

Not: 'What's the budget?' Not: 'What's the date?'

It's: 'What do you want people to feel when they walk out the door?'

When an HR or marketing leader can answer that with one clear sentence, every other decision — venue, format, flow, finale — practically makes itself. When they can't, no budget in the world fixes it.

We've built our entire process around that single question. It's why 25,000+ participants across our events didn't just attend — they remembered.

What's the one feeling you want your next event to leave behind? Drop it in the comments — would love to hear how you're thinking about it.
